profile.name: Justin Gabriel Moreira Matarrita
profile.title: Information Systems Engineer
profile.tagline: Building software with intention, clean architecture, and steady focus.
profile.summary: Advanced Information Systems Engineering student, passionate about analyzing complex problems and building reliable, maintainable solutions. Proactive, collaborative, and quick to adapt to new environments and technologies.

about.titleEnd: when ideas become systems that work.
paragraphs: I am an advanced Information Systems Engineering student in Costa Rica. My work sits at the intersection of clean architecture, practical problem-solving, and constant collaboration—whether modeling data in MySQL, building a Laravel backend, or composing a React interface.

Beyond coding, I enjoy teaching. I have facilitated robotics workshops for high school students and supported classmates in Robotic Process Automation courses with UiPath. Explaining complex ideas in simple, calm language makes me a better engineer.
I value craftsmanship, honest communication, and delivering work I would still be happy to maintain a year from now.

skills.title: Tools I rely on.
skills.description: A toolkit shaped by university coursework, mentoring, and real engineering projects. Always learning, always refining.

experience.title: Where I have learned, taught, and delivered results.

bullets: Built an end-to-end management system for a veterinary clinic alongside the team using Laravel.
Applied software engineering practices for requirements analysis, architectural design, and data modeling.
Guided the team through full Scrum adoption: sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.
Designed and facilitated educational robotics workshops for high school students.
Built robots and adapted teaching material to different learning levels.
Supported teams with practical problem-solving and continuous iteration.
Supported classmates in the Robotic Process Automation (UiPath) course.
Answered questions and explained course concepts to reinforce learning.
Guided them through exercises and the progress of their automations.

items.title: SafeZone
items.subtitle: Team project · 4 members
items.description: Collaborative urban-safety platform: the community reports incidents in real time and the system corroborates them by zone and time to compute a risk score.

parts.name: API
parts.stack: .NET 8 · C# · YARP · EF Core · PostgreSQL + PostGIS · Redis · Kafka (Redpanda) · JWT · Docker · Python · FastAPI · spaCy · scikit-learn
parts.summary: Gateway (YARP) and separate services: authentication, incidents, community and a Python risk service that classifies reports (NLP) and computes the score per zone (H3).

parts.name: Web
parts.stack: React 18 · TypeScript · Vite · Tailwind · Radix UI · TanStack Query · Zustand · React Hook Form · Zod · Leaflet · Recharts
parts.summary: Admin portal for users, terms and analytics.

parts.name: Mobile app
parts.stack: Expo · React Native · TypeScript · Expo Router · MapLibre · TanStack Query · Zustand · Zod · MMKV · Jest
parts.summary: App to report incidents and see the risk of the area.

items.title: STEAM Robotics website
items.subtitle: UNA · Sarapiquí campus
items.description: Website for the Universidad Nacional course Robotics for the Development of STEAM Skills. It gathers resources and simulators for teachers and students at rural high schools, plus interactive weekly guides for the course.
highlights: Resources and simulators for LEGO EV3, SPIKE Prime, Open Roberta and Arduino
Interactive weekly guides that build the structure of the assignment document
Automatic publishing with GitHub Actions: the source stays private and only the site is published

items.title: La VuelTica
items.subtitle: UNA · team of 5
items.description: Helps people decide where to eat: shows nearby food businesses on a map, with digital menus, promotions, ratings and a gastronomic dice to pick at random.

parts.name: API
parts.stack: C# · .NET 8 · EF Core · PostgreSQL + PostGIS · JWT · Docker
parts.summary: Business logic, geospatial proximity queries and authentication.

parts.name: Mobile app
parts.stack: Native Android · Kotlin · Jetpack Compose · Hilt · Retrofit · Room
parts.summary: Android app with map, posts feed, digital menu and promotions.

items.title: EventBooking
items.subtitle: UNA · team of 5
items.description: Event booking system: a business publishes and manages its events, and customers search, book and cancel from their phone.

parts.name: API
parts.stack: Python · FastAPI · SQLAlchemy 2 · PostgreSQL · Alembic · JWT · Docker
parts.summary: Events, reservations, notifications and authentication exposed as a REST API.

parts.name: Mobile app
parts.stack: Expo · React Native · TypeScript · Expo Router · Jest
parts.summary: Calendar and event management for the business; search, booking and cancellation for customers.

items.title: Veterinary management system
items.subtitle: UNA · team of 5
items.description: System for Agroveterinaria Río Frío: appointment scheduling, shopping cart and inventory control with per-user permissions. Delivered and deployed to a live environment as the final project.
highlights: Laravel backend modules: appointments, inventory and business logic
JavaScript interface for the appointment scheduler and the cart
Deployed to a live environment as the final delivery
